promise: Remember anyone. Find the right person when they can help.
one_liner: Remember anyone. Find the right person when they can help.
description: Circle helps independent operators save people from whatever they have, remember why each person mattered, browse everyone, and bring useful people back while searching or working through a business idea.
category: personal contact memory for independent operators
supersedes: Older descriptions of a one-plane capture interface, relationship-to-revenue engine, overnight drafted actions, or $30/$79 tiers are retired.
primary_user: Fractional executives and independent operators who meet useful people but do not want to maintain a CRM. This is a commercial hypothesis, not proven market evidence.
anti_icp: Sales teams needing deal stages, forecasting, seat management, pipeline reporting, or automated outreach.

claim_classes.verified_product_fact: Supported by current source and verified release evidence.
claim_classes.commercial_hypothesis: Useful for targeting or drafting, but not proven market evidence.
claim_classes.retired_or_unverified: Must not be presented as current or factual.

buyer.primary: Fractional executives and independent operators who meet useful people but do not want to maintain a CRM.
buyer.painful_moment: A useful person is already somewhere in the operator's world, but the operator cannot remember the name, context, or relevance when a real need appears.
qualifying_signals: Relationship context is spread across several places.
The user wants to save someone quickly without maintaining a formal record.
The user needs to find people while working through a business idea.
The user needs personal recall rather than team pipeline management.
disqualifying_signals: Needs deal stages, forecasting, territories, seat controls, or manager reporting.
Wants bulk automated outreach or automatic introductions.
Requires guaranteed enrichment or web-wide people search.
Requires native iOS share-sheet intake today.

message.changed_belief: Keeping a useful network searchable does not have to require disciplined CRM upkeep. One imperfect note can preserve the context and make a person findable later.
hierarchy: Outcome: remember anyone and find the right person later.
Ease: add whatever you have; a name is enough to save.
Context: add where you met or why they mattered if useful.
Use: browse everyone, ask who could help, or work through an idea.
Trust: see why someone matched and remain in control of every contact action.
message.approved_one_sentence: Circle helps independent operators save people from whatever they have and find the right saved person when they can help.
message.approved_short_description: Add a name, note, link, voice memo, or photo. Circle keeps the details together, lets you browse everyone, and brings useful people back when you search or work through an idea. You see why someone matched, and you decide what happens next.
message.approved_cta: Start with one person you do not want to forget.

active_flow: People: browse everyone, ask who could help, add one person, or bring in contacts.
Ideas: start from a rough thought or reopen an earlier idea.
You: manage profile, connected contacts, reminders, privacy, and account settings.
Circle preserves original contact input and uses the existing dedupe pipeline.
Circle returns saved people with reasons grounded in stored evidence.
live: Text, link, email, phone inside a note, voice, photo, supported device-contact, and Android PWA share intake
LinkedIn or CRM file, Google, and Microsoft import entry points
Recent idea history, new idea capture, and exact-run reopen
Exact saved-name recall without an LLM or paid search dependency

Profile, connected contacts, reminders, appearance, privacy, and account settings
